alkylation reagent: alkylated in 55 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 20 min
alkylation concentration: alkylated in 55 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 20 min
cleavage agent: proteins were digested with trypsin, as previously described
enrichment method: GST-tagged C terminus Repo-Man or GST alone
GST-tagged C terminus Repo-Man or GST alone were used as baits to isolate HeLa nucleosomes with high affinity for Repo-Man
fractionation method: Part of the chromatin eluted from the GST:Repo-Man or GST alone was loaded on an SDS–PAGE then stained with Instant Blue (Expedeon)
instrument: MS-analyses were performed either on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) or on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: no labeling strategy is mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
reduction reagent: proteins were reduced in 10 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma) for 30 min at 37 °C
reduction concentration: proteins were reduced in 10 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma) for 30 min at 37 °C
